sourceType.description: The full CloudEvents type of the source fact.

sourceSubject.description: The subject of the source fact (its aggregate id).

siteId.description: The site carried by the source fact; null when it has none.

status.description:
The fixed status machine: `OPEN -> TRIAGED -> ASSIGNED -> RESOLVED`.
`RESOLVED` is terminal. `ESCALATED` is a flag, not a status.

severity.description: The triage outcome, from the policy or an operator.

occurrenceCount.description: How many times the source fact arrived; 1 at open and +1 per repeat.

escalated.description: Set by the SLA sweeper at breach; never blocks a transition.

assignee.description: The owning operator id; absent before the first assignment.

note.description: Absent until RESOLVED; null when resolved without a note.

resolvedAt.description: Absent until the case is resolved or auto-resolved.

autoResolveRuleId.description: The rule that fired, present only on an auto-resolved case.

lastSeenAt.description: The arrival time of the most recent occurrence.

slaDueAt.description: openedAt + the policy's slaMinutes at open.

sourceEventId.description: The CloudEvents id of the source fact that opened the case.

sourcePayload.description: The frozen copy of the source fact's data; never changes after open.

auditTrail.description: One entry per transition, in order; every entry records its actor.

action.description: One of OPENED, TOUCHED, TRIAGED, ASSIGNED, ESCALATED, RESOLVED, AUTO_RESOLVED.

actor.description: The operator id, the policy id or `system`.
